authority.rule: The frozen b311 initial profile is effective except where this addendum explicitly supersedes it.
authority.separateLengthProtocolState: unchanged; separately assigned freeze/authorization remains required

items: b311 C1 CLI, output, multidocument order, refusals, language, numeric, E1 status, accounting, retention, and lifecycle except explicit amendments below
fixed private inclusive caps and admissions
truthful sole-token help/version behavior, with exact bytes pending root check
quoted, block-style, or explicitly !!str-tagged literal << string keys; only plain untagged << is rejected
finite and safe-integral numeric policy and stated Decimal range, with independent range-binding verification still required
direct-handler/raw-failure boundary and qualified outer-Shell behavior
exact help and version bytes in exactInformation
public factory signatures and runtime option validation in publicApi
private adapter signatures and lifecycle in privateAdapter
complete finite normal diagnostic catalogue and deterministic selection
the two bounded primary-spec choices in yamlGrammarReview

fixedPrivateCaps.comparison: all maxima are inclusive; checked safe-integer projection fails before the bounded operation
argvAdmission: CommandContext.args excludes context.command; count exactly args.length, including optional eval/e, every option/value, --, filter, and path.

Check maxArgvEntries before traversing strings. Then validate every JS string as well-formed Unicode and accumulate Buffer.byteLength(argument, utf8) with overflow-safe subtraction/addition, never a whole-argv encoded buffer.
After roles are parsed, check each literal non-dash VFS operand's own UTF-8 bytes against maxVfsOperandPathBytes. The filter is governed by maxQuerySourceBytes; '-' is not a VFS path.

Complete all CLI grammar, duplicate, compatibility, stdin-count, and path admission before parse(), stdin iteration, any input VFS call, or stdout acquisition. No invalid CLI can cause query/input VFS work.

cliAmendments.informationCombinationRule: After whole-argv count/byte/Unicode admission, any occurrence of -h, --help, or --version not matching one exact form above is status 2 CLI_INFO_COMBINATION, including a form containing -- or another argument. There is no -v.
cliAmendments.informationEffects: Status 0 and the exact fixed stdout bytes only. Do not create a query session/Budget, compile, inspect or acquire stdin, or make input VFS calls. Register cleanup before any accepted owned stdout operation and preserve write/backpressure/raw-failure semantics.
cliAmendments.jsonOnly: -c/--compact-output and -r/--unwrapScalar each require an explicit -o json, --output-format json, or --output-format=json in that invocation.
cliAmendments.unchanged: All other C1 grammar, output bytes, result/document order, and explicit refusals in b311 remain effective. There is no eval-all, slurp, write, schema, input-format, null-input, variable, program-file, document-selection, or new flag.

exactInformation.help:
virtual-bash restricted YAML profile
usage: yq [eval|e] [OPTION ...] [--] [FILTER [FILE ...]]
       yq [eval|e] --help
       yq [eval|e] --version
options:
  -o, --output-format FORMAT  FORMAT is yaml or json
      --output-format=FORMAT  same as above
  -c, --compact-output       compact JSON; requires -o json

      --version              show profile identity (sole argument)
exactInformation.identityClaim: profile identity only; no Mike Farah or package version is claimed

mergeLikeKeys: A scalar string key whose decoded content is << is ordinary data unless its presentation is plain and untagged.
Reject only a plain untagged << key as SCHEMA_PLAIN_MERGE_KEY; perform no merge behavior.
Accept single-quoted, double-quoted, block-style, or explicitly tag:yaml.org,2002:str/!!str forms as the ordinary string key <<, subject to duplicate/string limits.
Reject tag:yaml.org,2002:merge/!!merge and every other non-allow-listed tag as SCHEMA_UNSUPPORTED_TAG.
languageAmendments.yaml122Finding: YAML 1.2.2 grammar and Core resolution make plain untagged << a valid string; the rejection above is an intentional presentation-sensitive anti-extension restriction. The merge URI/shorthand belongs to the separate YAML 1.1 merge working draft and is not a YAML 1.2.2 Core tag.
languageAmendments.implicitKeyGrammar: YAML 1.2.2 implicit keys remain single-line and at most 1024 Unicode code points. This production rule is not a configurable safety cap or second limit vector; explicit-key notation remains available subject to maxScalarBytes.
languageAmendments.unchanged: All other b311 Core resolution, string-only key, decoded-key duplicate, accepted-tag, kind/lexeme, anchor, alias, document, and syntax rules remain effective, subject only to yamlGrammarReview.

numericAmendments.rules: Retain b311 lexical bounded conversion, finite input/result, exact safe-integral admission, normalized Decimal exponent interval [-1147483646, 999999999], and recursive yielded-graph checks. Do not use BigInt or allocate powers of ten.
numericAmendments.qualification: This author verified the literals only, not the independent correctness/binding review required before code.

rules: createYqCommand and createYqCommands accept no options because fixed caps have no DI/configuration point; only plugin registration consumes replace.

yqCommands validates a non-null object, permits no own enumerable option other than replace, reads replace exactly once before creating definitions or touching a host, and accepts only undefined or boolean; undefined means false.
setup preflights the complete one-command collision set when replace is false, then registers yq with { replace }; no partial registration.
No YqLimits, defaultYqLimits, parser, query session, or adapter type is public. No export code is authorized by this document.

privateAdapter.typeBinding: Json is the existing src/commands/structured/limits.ts Json and includes existing Decimal; Ast remains private inside the session. parse, Interpreter, Budget, Budget.value, and stringify are reused, not copied or publicly exported.
lifecycle: createYqQuerySession reads/validates the borrowed signal once, builds one frozen internal JqLimits mapping from fixed caps, one empty ReadonlyMap<string, Json>, one Budget, and one Interpreter. It exposes no Budget reference or mutable/reset counters.

compileOnce synchronously marks the session compile-attempted before calling parse. Success stores one Ast. Failure is terminal; it is not retried. A second compile attempt or run before success is an internal misuse error, not a mapped language failure.

run serializes one active input at a time, uses the stored Ast/Interpreter, preserves engine yield order, and closes the current engine generator in finally. Completion/failure releases the run slot; close prevents new runs and returns the active generator once.
close closes admission first, is idempotent, shares one completion across overlapping calls, and observes generator return failure. No query worker, lease, child, or scheduler is invented.

The yq boundary recursively validates/measures each engine yield once, calls admitResult once after validation and before encoding/publication, and never increments results elsewhere. Existing engine measurements/steps for its own intermediates remain untouched.

ownedWork is the only yq scanner/encoder access to shared Budget step/tick/input/output/result/value/stringify operations. Additional document/anchor/alias/node/scalar/stdout counters remain in one non-resettable private yq ledger.

Every ownedWork count is checked as a nonnegative safe integer; step count must be positive when supplied. Admit methods use overflow-safe projection and expose no decrement, assignment, reset, limits replacement, or raw Budget.
Information and CLI-failure paths create no query session. A normal compile failure creates no input/output acquisition; only its bounded stderr diagnostic may be attempted afterward.
privateAdapter.scope: New private adapter and new yq module only; no parser/interpreter copy, broad refactor, async compiler wrapper, public query bridge, eval-all, slurp, or implementation before a different freeze.

diagnostics.source: SOURCE is literal <stdin> or a valid JSON string whose complete field, including opening/closing quotes, is at most 256 UTF-8 bytes. Filename controls, quote, and backslash are JSON-escaped; other well-formed non-ASCII Unicode scalars remain literal UTF-8. Incremental truncation keeps a scalar only when its complete escaped bytes plus an in-string ASCII ... and closing quote fit that inclusive cap. Thus framing tokens are ASCII but a filename field may be non-ASCII.
diagnostics.location: One-based line/column appear only from truthful structured parser data; never infer them from opaque query/VFS errors.
diagnostics.admission: Prefer one complete diagnostic write admitted against the 4096-byte reserve and combined output limit. If it cannot fit, try the exact fallback; if that cannot fit, submit nothing. Admission is atomic accounting, not transactional sink delivery.

selection: First apply argv entry count; then scan strings in index order for invalid Unicode and aggregate byte admission; then give CLI_INFO_COMBINATION precedence when an information token is present in a non-exact form.

Otherwise parse left-to-right. Immediate missing/invalid/refused/unknown errors win at their token; a duplicate wins at its second spelling; path/stdin errors win at the offending operand. After parsing, CLI_INCOMPATIBLE_OPTIONS is the sole postcheck.

A named limit always maps to its exact limit code (except the three CLI caps). Otherwise the first failure in operand, document, source-offset, composition, query-yield, validation, encode, and submit order is selected and stops further input.

No unknown exception is collapsed to a catalogue code: internal/programmer errors escape. Diagnostic rendering failure never replaces caller abort, sink/owned-output rejection, escaping control/execution failure, or cleanup failure.

outputAccounting.stdoutCap: 16773120 inclusive; maxOutputBytes 16777216 minus 4096 reserved for stderr diagnostics
outputAccounting.resultOrder: Validate a yield, admit exactly one result, encode/preflight the entire document including YAML separator and LF, then admit all exact stdout bytes before the first sink write and before requesting another yield.
outputAccounting.encoderPreallocation: A private actual-output projection checks each escape, indentation run, fragment, separator, and LF against remaining stdout/combined capacity before retaining that fragment or allocating repeat/join/suffix/final-byte output. The global output counter advances once for the complete submit operation, not once per fragment.
outputAccounting.failureQualification: An admitted operation is charged in full and never reclaimed even if a sink accepts zero bytes, a prefix, or all bytes before rejecting. The counter is admitted-for-submission bytes, not physically written bytes. Earlier complete writes remain; no rollback/transaction is claimed.
outputAccounting.prettyAndRaw: Compact graph measure counts compact escaped JSON bytes. Actual output counts selected YAML or JSON formatting, raw string bytes, every separator, and final LF.

workUnits.owned: Call Budget.step once per decoded Unicode code point, emitted token/event, composed node, alias-copied node, recursively validated node, and encoded node. For every distinct nonempty retained-copy, decoded-append, alias-payload-copy, encoder-fragment emit, or sink-submit operation, also charge ceil(operation UTF-8 bytes / 1024); splitting cannot create free payload work and may increase charges.
workUnits.checkpoint: After no more than 1023 yq-owned units without an await, call Budget.tick. tick itself adds the existing extra step and may yield only at Budget's private threshold; this promises neither an exact yield period nor observable callbacks.
workUnits.compiler: Argv validation, source-byte admission, fixed tokenizer/token/AST allocation, validation, regex and diagnostics are not claimed as maxSteps work. parse is synchronous and retains only its actual existing charges, notably Decimal conversion; source/AST caps are admissions, not hard preemption.
workUnits.engine: Retain every existing interpreter/Decimal/collection/value step. The adapter adds no query-instruction, allocation, promise, scheduler, or opaque-host charge.

retention.inventory: R owned raw fragments, T decoded text, token/composition/anchor metadata, M expanded input, source/AST and opaque engine intermediates, Q current yield, E encoder fragments plus joined text, suffixed text, and final Uint8Array may coexist.
retention.knownPayloadEnvelope: M + Q + max(2E, 3E + 2s), with s separator/newline bytes
retention.qualification: This conservative logical-payload formula excludes metadata, JS string representation/ropes, allocator slack, GC lag, provider preallocation, and engine internals. A streaming provider may allocate before yielding, and fallback readFile may allocate before honoring/rejecting maxBytes; cancellation cannot undo that. Fixed caps are not an aggregate retained-heap, RSS, CPU, latency, live-lease, transaction, ABA, race, or hard-preemption guarantee.

failureAndCleanupBoundary.directHandler: CommandDefinition.execute maps only catalogue normal failures to {exitCode}. Before/after any diagnostic attempt it preserves exact caller-signal reason; otherwise sink/accepted-owned-output rejection including EPIPE and escaping execution/control rejection; otherwise cleanup rejection. A primary raw failure wins while every admitted cleanup rejection is observed.
failureAndCleanupBoundary.outerShell: Shell/registry routing retains its own authenticated cancellation, downstream-close, pipeline, middleware, and cleanup selection. This addendum does not promise that every sink/owned-output event always rejects outer Shell.exec; it promises that yq does not remap it to a normal language status.
failureAndCleanupBoundary.ownership: Borrow context.signal. Register one shared idempotent close synchronously before input/output acquisition/admission and call the same close from finally. Close admissions first and drain admitted cooperative work. Use separate stdout/stderr createOutputOperation instances only when that destination advertises ownedOutput; a stdout consumer close does not cancel stderr, VFS/header work, siblings, or the whole context. Wrapping alone creates no ownership.
failureAndCleanupBoundary.limits: Cancellation cannot undo completed effects or forcibly stop synchronous parse/uncooperative host work. Optional registerCleanup omission leaves finally cleanup but creates no outer settlement barrier.

verified: node properties productions 96-97 and quoted/plain productions 107-135
YAML 1.1 merge working draft only as exclusion context: https://yaml.org/type/merge.html
diagnoses: b311 invokes nb-json inside quoted scalars but also rejects raw U+FFFE/U+FFFF and forbidden raw controls there. Production 2 permits TAB and U+0020-U+10FFFF in quoted content (subject to quote/backslash grammar), including DEL/C1 and U+FFFE/U+FFFF; c-printable's narrower exclusions govern elsewhere.

YAML 1.2.2 permits anchor-name reuse and makes an alias target the most recent preceding matching anchor. b311 instead requires unique anchor names. Its already-explicit completed-anchor, no-current/cycle, deep-copy rules are also a deliberate graph-safety subset and remain adopted.

choices.A: Align to YAML 1.2.2 nb-json: accept those well-formed raw quoted characters, while escaping non-c-printable content on output.
choices.B: Retain b311's rejection and label it an intentional restricted-profile subset rather than YAML grammar conformance.

choices.A: Align to YAML 1.2.2: permit anchor-name reuse and resolve an alias to the most recent preceding completed matching anchor, while retaining the no-current/cycle and deep-copy safety rules.
choices.B: Retain b311 unique anchor names and label that rule an intentional restricted-profile subset.
